summary.name: DaisyDisk
summary.one_liner: DaisyDisk is a Mac disk space analyzer that scans storage and shows usage as an interactive colorful ring map, letting you find and delete large files and folders.
keywords: scan cloud storage dropbox google drive onedrive
use_cases: Find out what is taking up space on a Mac
Locate and delete large unneeded files
Purge macOS snapshots taking up space
Scan external, network or cloud drives for usage
Free space on a low-storage Mac or small SSD
summary.what_it_does: DaisyDisk scans a disk and displays space usage broken down by files and folders as interactive, colorful rings, so you can drill into folders and select items to remove by drag and drop. It can scan as administrator to reach restricted files, and it can expose the breakdown of the "Other" and "System Data" categories. It also lists snapshots that may use space and can connect to and remotely scan cloud storage such as Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive and Box. The page says it calculates physically used space, excluding clones and hard links, and lets you preview files with the Space key.
notable: Interactive ring-based disk map with drag-and-drop deletion
Exposes 'Other' and 'System Data' storage and macOS snapshots
Scans cloud storage (Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive, Box)
Lifetime license with no subscription, use on up to 5 personal Macs
caveats: Paid one-time purchase; price not stated on the page
Corporate, portable and student licenses require contacting the vendor
